scenario: A 'QR code scanner' app requests SMS permissions unrelated to its stated function.

supported_findings: The app requests SEND_SMS and READ_SMS permissions, which are not required for QR code scanning.
Strings reference a premium SMS shortcode (premium_sms_shortcode_9012) and an SMS-send confirmation flow.
The certificate is self-signed with a 10-year validity and unpopulated issuer fields.
unsupported_claims_to_watch_for: Any claim that a premium-rate SMS was actually sent -- no traffic_log or SMS log entries in this case confirm an outbound message occurred.
Any claim attributing SMS charges to a specific person's phone bill.
